# ACE UAE

> > ACE UAE is the official online retail store offering home improvement products, garden supplies, hardware, furniture, camping equipment, power tools, and air purification systems across the United Arab Emirates.

ACE UAE serves as a comprehensive e-commerce platform for home and outdoor living needs, featuring trusted brands like Maglite, Blueair, Dewalt, Coleman, and Bestway. The store specializes in hardware solutions, storage systems, camping gear, and advanced air purification technology including HEPASilent and HINS filtration systems.
